note: These rows map problem types to a public-authority category. PIO names are never invented. Each row cites an official page.

authorities.label_en: State Food & Civil Supplies / PDS department (State public authority)
authorities.label_hi: राज्य खाद्य एवं नागरिक आपूर्ति / सार्वजनिक वितरण प्रणाली विभाग
authorities.file_online_note: Do not use rtionline.gov.in for State authorities. File with the State PIO or the State RTI portal if one exists.
authorities.source_title: RTI Online portal — Central authorities only

authorities.label_en: State School Education / Scholarship department (State public authority)
authorities.file_online_note: State education departments are not Central public authorities. Do not file on rtionline.gov.in.
authorities.source_title: RTI Online portal — Central authorities only

authorities.label_en: State Social Welfare / pension department (State public authority)
authorities.file_online_note: State social-welfare / pension offices are not Central public authorities. Do not file on rtionline.gov.in unless the scheme is Central (e.g. NSAP).
authorities.source_title: RTI Online portal — Central authorities only

authorities.label_en: Urban local body / municipality (State public authority)
authorities.file_online_note: Municipal bodies are State public authorities. File with the municipal PIO.
authorities.source_title: RTI Online portal — Central authorities only

authorities.label_en: State electricity distribution company / DISCOM (often a State public authority)
authorities.file_online_note: Most DISCOMs are State entities. Confirm whether the DISCOM is a public authority under RTI s.2(h) before filing.

authorities.label_en: District / State / National Consumer Commission via e-Jagriti
authorities.label_hi: जिला / राज्य / राष्ट्रीय उपभोक्ता आयोग — e-Jagriti
authorities.file_online_note: File consumer complaints on e-jagriti.gov.in. This is not an RTI to a ministry.

authorities.label_en: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (Central public authority)
authorities.file_online_note: EPFO is Central. Confirm the public authority on rtionline.gov.in before filing.

authorities.label_en: State Labour Department / Labour Commissioner (via labour.gov.in)
authorities.file_online_note: Locate the live State labour office from the Union labour portal. Do not invent IDA section numbers.

authorities.label_en: National Human Rights Commission / State Human Rights Commission (HRCNet)
authorities.file_online_note: Lodge on HRCNet. Choose NHRC or the State Commission. This is not an RTI and not e-Jagriti.

authorities.label_en: Concerned Central Ministry / Department (file on RTI Online)
authorities.file_online_note: Indian citizens may file RTI applications for Central public authorities at rtionline.gov.in.
